NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: OlympIQ uses this only when you choose a profile picture — for example, picking a photo for your child's profile so they can recognise their own account. The photo is stored only as a profile image and is never used for anything else.
NSFaceIDUsageDescription: OlympIQ uses Face ID only to unlock the app, and only if you switch that on yourself under Account. Your face data never leaves your device.
